prompt:
Production Unity enemy Swarmer animation sheet. Input reference is exact silhouette, proportions and view, not a frame to duplicate. Redraw the same creature with articulated animated poses. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray tendon limbs, subtle amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D, elevated 45deg camera fixed, soft upper-left light. Very low, flat, small quadruped scout with one broad smooth wedge-shaped brown rocky carapace covering its back, small pointed front head with a narrow amber eye slit, pale gray tendon limbs splayed laterally, FOUR limbs only. No dorsal organs, no horns, no tall ridges. Keep the low turtle/beetle silhouette of the reference.
Direction MUST remain REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-left, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-left. Never front-left. throughout all frames. Front limbs/head point toward top, hind limbs nearest bottom in rear views. When doing a slam, keep HIND feet nearest viewer braced on ground; raise the FRONT feet far from viewer.
FOUR COLUMNS, 4 ROWS, exactly 16 full creatures, SQUARE image width:height=4:4. Generous 20% transparent space around each sprite within its cell. Never overlap/touch any adjacent frame. Same body scale and foot anchor each frame. Rows1-2: EIGHT distinct sequential WALK frames, alternating diagonal foot pairs lift and plant with a continuous scuttling gait, torso stays nearly level. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breathing poses, planted feet, subtle living tissues, no whole-body scaling. Row4: FOUR distinct DEATH poses: legs progressively buckle, carapace settles onto floor, head rests, eye goes dark; a quiet non-explosive collapse.
Four consistent limbs, one head, same armor layout. No duplicate stills, no rotation-only simulation. Fully transparent background alpha0 and clean transparent gaps between legs. No floor or cast shadows, no text/labels/grid, no particles, no projectile.
